Read an infrared JCAMP-DX spectrum

Source: R/jcamp-read.R
measure_read_jcamp.Rd

Import one continuous infrared spectrum into a measure_record(). Supply the identities from your experiment. The file title is descriptive metadata and may be shared by many acquisitions.

Usage

measure_read_jcamp(
  path,
  sample_id,
  injection_id,
  channel_id,
  curve_id,
  source_id,
  max_bytes = 64 * 1024^2
)

measure_jcamp_headers(path, max_bytes = 64 * 1024^2)

Arguments

path

Path to a local JCAMP-DX text file.

sample_id, injection_id, channel_id, curve_id, source_id

Single, nonblank character identifiers for the sample, injection, detector channel, curve, and original file, respectively.

max_bytes

Maximum input size in bytes. Defaults to 64 MiB.

Value

measure_read_jcamp() returns a validated measure_record. The source table contains the input filename and SHA-256 digest of the bytes parsed. The source ordinals count spectral points in acquisition order.

measure_jcamp_headers() returns a tibble of label and value in source order. It retains original label spellings and repeat entries. Comments, surrounding whitespace, and data rows are omitted. Multiline declarations use a newline between lines. Reading headers does not validate the numeric spectrum.

Details

The reader supports a single infrared block with plain numeric (AFFN) data, in either XYPOINTS=(XY..XY) or XYDATA=(X++(Y..Y)) form. Explicit pairs keep their individual coordinates. For a regular grid the first coordinate, last coordinate, and point count define the axis. Declared scale factors apply to the stored numbers. An ordinate marked ? becomes NA_real_. The record keeps the declared units and any explicit XLABEL and YLABEL axis and response names. The maximum spectrum length is one million points.

Use measure_jcamp_headers() to inspect declarations such as title, origin, owner, acquisition settings, and instrument-specific fields. Keep the original file for the complete acquisition metadata. Use measure_write_jcamp() to exchange one curve and write_measure_record() to save all five record tables.

References

IUPAC JCAMP-DX specifications

Examples

path <- system.file("extdata", "ir-film.jdx", package = "measure")
headers <- measure_jcamp_headers(path)
headers[headers$label %in% c("TITLE", "ORIGIN", "OWNER"), ]
#> # A tibble: 3 × 2
#>   label  value                  
#>   <chr>  <chr>                  
#> 1 TITLE  Simulated film spectrum
#> 2 ORIGIN measure examples       
#> 3 OWNER  measure contributors   
record <- measure_read_jcamp(path, "film", "scan-01", "ir", "film-ir", "file-01")
spectrum <- record$curves$.measures[[1]]
spectrum[which.max(spectrum$value), ]
#> <measure_tbl [1 x 2]>
#> # A tibble: 1 × 2
#>   location value
#>      <dbl> <dbl>
#> 1     1736 0.455
